sum: Powerus Corporation, a defense technology company, builds and scales unified autonomous systems. Its systems are designed to move, protect, and sustain critical assets in high-risk environments with capabilities covering heavy-lift platforms, autonomous air systems, autonomous maritime systems, mission systems, training and support, and U.S.-based manufacturing. The company also owns and manages golf courses in the Orlando, Florida region. The company was founded in 2025 and is based in Rock Hill, South Carolina.
